purpose: Evaluate one fixed long-only monthly liquidity-improvement hypothesis without changing the current strategy or project kill-switch adjudication.

source_boundary.paper_title: Liquidity changes and decomposition in the Japanese equity market
source_boundary.claim: This configuration is an independently specified proxy inspired by the paper's public abstract, not a replication of LIQC or its decomposition.

universe.null_bar_handling: Rows with null adjusted close or null/nonpositive turnover are not valid symbol sessions and are never filled. Windows use the most recent valid symbol sessions only.
universe.survivorship_rule: Use only the historical master snapshot at or before each signal date; never use current master membership.

feature.prior_window: 20 valid symbol sessions immediately preceding the current window
feature.current_window: 20 valid symbol sessions ending on the signal date
feature.positive_sign_meaning: Liquidity improved because price impact per JPY traded decreased.
feature.cross_sectional_transform: Descending deterministic rank by feature, then issue code

selection.eligible_count_rounding: ceil(eligible_cross_section_count * 0.20), with a minimum of one when the eligible cross-section is nonempty

execution.stop_fill: After applying the day's split factor: open if open is at or below stop, otherwise stop when low reaches stop.
execution.corporate_action_handling: On an ex-date, multiply raw price references by AdjFactor and divide shares by AdjFactor before evaluating that session.

splits.boundary_rule: A trade belongs to a split only when signal, entry, and scheduled or stop exit all occur no later than that split's end date.

evaluation.maximum_drawdown: Maximum peak-to-trough decline of daily mark-to-market portfolio equity including open positions and costs.

decision_contract.development_fail: Freeze this candidate. Do not inspect validation or alter windows, sign, threshold, stop, or costs under the same candidate ID.
decision_contract.validation_fail_or_inconclusive: Freeze this candidate. Do not inspect locked OOS.
decision_contract.locked_oos_pass: Permits only a separately approved prospective shadow-forward design; it does not authorize paper/live routing.
